endpoint.recipe: explicit EndpointOverride(opensearch_data, opensearch_2_18, exact account/project/region/pool scope), HTTPS root cluster node endpoint with caller TLS/CA transport; no DBaaS URL inference
endpoint.auth: Basic with explicit protected engine username/password CredentialSource, never IAM token
endpoint.scope: caller-declared cluster endpoint and credential binding; response has no project field and does not prove cloud ownership

request.parameters: all documented query pointers; omitted vs explicit false/empty retained; no server defaults inserted
request.fields: exact Selectel12 options, typed flat fields; protected JSON scalar numbers/string/boolean/null preserved unchanged; persistent/transient separate; null resets exact key only
excluded_variants: nested update syntax (equivalent flat keys supported)
request.private_disclosure: protected values revealed only into outgoing resource request; JSON/text/fmt of public DTO stays protected

response.fields: all persistent/transient/defaults objects retained as ProtectedJSON including unknown provider fields and exact numbers; acknowledged boolean retained on PUT even false
response.required: persistent/transient objects; PUT acknowledged; malformed success retains accepted receipt
response.numbers: raw JSON bytes, no float64 conversion

errors.transport_lost: unknown_outcome with receipt for PUT; never replay

retry: bounded safe GET; PUT never replayed, no documented replay guarantee
wait: unavailable; acknowledged false is preserved, does not establish effective configuration
recovery: unavailable; exact Get is observation without attribution, no automatic replay
verification: offline only; not full OpenSearch protocol coverage
